question: Approve the validation of DEV-80 (Forge Phase 2 clean runner + scenario slot) at candidate revision aafa538b, now that the implementation-exit surface map has been produced and independently checked, so it returns to Captain-authorized delivery on the existing Draft PR #368?

artifacts.summary: The surface map that the earlier approval was missing now exists and passes 12 of 12 changed non-test files; validation ran the check itself and reddened it twice with its own falsifiers rather than reading the build stage's claim. No surface qualified for removal: the two candidates named at dispatch were refuted by their live callers, and the three documentation lines whose without-it command is only a grep were traced to the work item's own recorded project-context and machine-dependency obligations. All five acceptance criteria carry a verdict, each with a falsifier distinct from the prior attempt's; the six declared proof and delivery checks are green. Two things the Captain rules on: the acceptance-criteria text for AC-2 still reads T1 and T4 against the gate-3 correction, and the existing Draft PR body predates this work and omits four of the five open residuals.
